summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the automated form generation system. It verifies the functionality and integration of form components by validating field rendering, data binding, and submission logic within an automated context.
responsibilities: Test automated form submission and validation logic
Validate component rendering and behavior under automated scenarios
relationships: Automated tests evaluate the rendering behavior of form fields to ensure they match expected specifications.
Form submission logic is verified through integrated test scenarios to ensure data consistency.
designDecisions: Co-location of test files with source features for easier maintenance
Utilization of automated test frameworks to validate declarative form structures
